It was supposed to be the safest deployment of the week. It became the longest incident of the year.
Every engineering team has that one story.
The outage nobody forgets.
The one that gets referenced every time someone says, “It’s just a tiny database change.”
For us, it started with a migration estimated to take five minutes.
One column.
One ALTER TABLE.
One deployment scheduled during off peak traffic.
Twelve hours later, our core service was still struggling to recover.
The funny part is that nothing actually crashed in the beginning. Servers were healthy. CPU usage looked normal. Kubernetes was happy. Grafana dashboards looked almost boring.
